topic: A digital miner is not hardware you can take home
hook: A GoMining digital miner is not a machine you can collect.

scenes.narration: GoMining sells digital miners: NFTs that represent a share of hashrate hosted in its data centres.
Digital miners are not redeemable for bitcoin. Owners earn rewards, they do not hold the hardware.
So the question is what the rewards look like after costs. That is what to check.

cta: What would you want to know first? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: GoMining Digital Miners: What You Don't Own
description_body: A digital miner represents hosted hashrate. You earn rewards, not hardware.
